name: Tomb Figure
summary: This is the figure of an attendant wearing a red hat, right hand resting on waist, standing on a rectangular plinth, the body made of pottery with cold-painted aubergine pigment. The figure's head is movable. This type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
